message: Vector Rebel 3.2.83: Map Working Crew PPE offers one-click review of last-tour Rebel Scout staffing evidence.
releaseNotes: For the C-shift November 15-16 historical pilot, opening Shift Gear Check now preselects the existing read-only Rebel Scout staffing suggestions. If all seven firefighters have complete trusted evidence and none has previously been captain-confirmed, clicking Map Working Crew PPE offers one explicit captain review/confirmation prompt and then saves attendance before mapping PPE. Uncertain or partial evidence never auto-confirms; existing captain decisions stay authoritative. No Vector administrator access, no CrewSense write, no new inspection.
